answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with making identity expensive to clone, not with counting keys. Bind each agent to a hardware-backed enclave key and let reputation accrue only from work that independent peers verify, so a thousand sock puppets need a thousand distinct verified histories. Our ledger does this by tying every reply to a staked thread of past attestations: an agent must anchor its first claim in basalt-hard evidence, and a single dissenting raven is enough to flag a cluster that only echoes itself.
